name: dev.ucp.common.location.lookup
title: Location Lookup
description: Location lookup by identifiers. Supports batch retrieval and single-location detail.

lookup_location.description: Location with required correlation metadata for lookup responses.

id.description: The identifier exactly as supplied in the lookup request.

inputs.description: Which request identifiers resolved to this Location. Each entry preserves one identifier exactly as supplied in the request.

lookup_request.description: Request body for batch location lookup. The Business resolves and deduplicates `ids` before applying `distance`, `serves`, and every supplied `filters` predicate; all structured predicates combine with AND.

ids.description: Identifiers of the Locations to look up. The Business MUST support canonical `Location.id` values and MAY support secondary or alias identifiers.

distance.description: Optional explicit-center radius predicate applied after ID resolution. It combines with `serves` and every supplied `filters` predicate using AND.

serves.description: Optional authoritative service-target predicate applied after ID resolution. It combines with `distance` and every supplied `filters` predicate using AND.

consistency_token.description: Optional opaque token from a capability event envelope (`consistency_token`). When supplied, the Business SHOULD serve the lookup from a replica at or past that state version.

locations.description: Locations matching the requested identifiers and refinements. May contain fewer Locations if some identifiers do not resolve or their resolved Locations are filtered out, or more if one identifier resolves to multiple Locations. When multiple identifiers resolve to the same Location, one returned Location carries all corresponding `inputs` entries.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the requested Locations, including `batch_limit_applied` when the Business processes only its configured maximum number of identifiers.

updated_event.title: Location Updated Event
updated_event.description: Notification that one or more Locations were added or had lookup fields modified.

location_ids.description: Canonical `Location.id` identifiers of the added or updated Locations.

changed_sections.description: Optional hint listing top-level `Location` fields that changed (e.g., `name`, `address`, `geo`, `hours`, `exception_hours`, `timezone`, `amenities`). Clients MUST tolerate unknown values. When omitted, any field may have changed.

removed_event.title: Location Removed Event
removed_event.description: Notification that one or more Locations are no longer served.

location_ids.description: Canonical `Location.id` identifiers of the removed Locations.

location_event.title: Location Event
location_event.description: Asynchronous webhook notification for location updates or removals.

location_ids.description: Canonical `Location.id` identifiers of the affected Locations.

changed_sections.description: Optional hint listing top-level `Location` fields that changed (`dev.ucp.common.location.lookup:updated` only; e.g., `name`, `address`, `geo`, `hours`, `exception_hours`, `timezone`, `amenities`). Clients MUST tolerate unknown values. When omitted, any field may have changed.

platform_schema.title: Location Lookup (Platform)
platform_schema.description: Platform-level location lookup capability declaration and optional webhook subscription.

webhook.description: Optional webhook subscription for location events.

business_schema.title: Location Lookup (Business)
business_schema.description: Business-level location lookup capability declaration and optional supported webhook events.

webhook.description: Supported location webhook event types emitted by this Business.

response_schema.title: Location Lookup (Response)
response_schema.description: Location lookup capability confirmation in responses, including echoed webhook subscription state.

webhook.description: Confirmed webhook event types active for the requesting Platform.
